title: Automatic upgrades begin rolling out row tracking and Checkpoint V2 to existing tables
body:
[Automatic upgrades](/aws/en/tables/automatic-upgrades) begin rolling out [row tracking](/aws/en/tables/features/row-tracking) and [Checkpoint V2](/aws/en/tables/features/checkpoint-v2) to existing Unity Catalog managed tables, not just new tables. This rollout is gradual, so these features will be available to different customers at different times.

Automatic upgrades turn on a feature only after the observation window verifies that every client accessing a table supports it. To track which features are available for automatic upgrades, see [Supported features](/aws/en/tables/automatic-upgrades#supported-features).
